text:
Ava: Heads up - landing in NYC Wednesday afternoon, staying near Hudson Yards. Need dinner recs that are casual and not $$$.
Diego: If you want casual + good cocktails, check out Queensyard (not the one in London) or Mercado Little Spain for quick tapas.
Sam: For a relaxed burger & shakes, try Black Iron Burger under the viaduct. Solid and walkable.
Ava: Any vegetarian-friendly spots around there?
Diego: Jacob's Pickles is a bit north but has great veg options and biscuits. Also, Sweetgreen is everywhere if you want something fast.
Sam: There's a really good Jewish deli, ``Best Bagels NYC`` (not the chain) - great brunch next day.
Ava: I'm also visiting London next month - any must-try late-night spots near Kings Cross?
Diego: For London: Dishoom (book ahead), Caravan for relaxed vibes, and "Bones & Barley" at the canal for small plates.
Sam: If you're after cheap eats late, the chicken shops on Caledonian Rd are top-tier.
Ava: Thanks! Back to SF folks - anyone at the office up for a group lunch Thurs at 12:15? @Diego @Sam
Diego: :thumbsup: count me in.
Sam: Might be short - heads down on a deploy, will RSVP by 11:30.
lunch-bot: Lunch poll created: "Group lunch Thu 12:15?" (react with :white_check_mark: for yes, :x: for no)
Ava: Also curious - what's the closest 24/7 coffee spot near Redwood SF office? Late work tonight.
Diego: Red Wire Coffee on 5th is open late till 1am on weekdays. If you need 24/7 the gas station espresso near Market is grim but works.
Sam: Theres a 24hr diner (Moonlight Diner) on 7th - classic late-night vibe.
Ava: Perfect, saved. I'll share a short doc with these recs once I land.
Diego: If you do, drop it in #lunch-plans pins. helps new hires.
